title: Where a current is k ≠ 0 times a relatively closed oriented C¹ submanifold, its support is that submanifold (parent step 6)
statement: Support of a locally represented current. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; T ∈ 𝒟_m(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U m); W, M ⊆ ℝ^P; k ∈ ℤ; ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m). Hypotheses: W is open and W ⊆ U; k ≠ 0; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); ξ is an orientation of M (IsOrientation m M ξ); M is relatively closed in W (closure(M) ∩ W ⊆ M); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ W; and T(ω) = k ∫_M ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^m(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Conclusion: spt T ∩ W = M ∩ W, where spt T = T.support = U ∖ T.zeroRegion and T.zeroRegion is the union of the open O with closure(O) compact and contained in U such that T(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ O. Here H^m = μHE[m].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U m) (W M : Set (Euclid P)) (k : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → k ≠ 0 → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → IsOrientation m M ξ → closure M ∩ W ⊆ M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ W → T ω = k * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → T.support ∩ W = M ∩ W
